mapper.select: /* com.portal.security.authority.AuthorManageMapper.selectAuthor */ SELECT AUTHOR_CODE AS authorCode, AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm, AUTHOR_DC AS authorDc, AUTHOR_CREAT_DE AS authorCreatDe FROM LETTNAUTHORINFO WHERE AUTHOR_CODE = #{authorCode}

/* com.portal.security.authority.AuthorManageMapper.selectAuthorListTotCnt */ SELECT COUNT(*) AS totcnt FROM LETTNAUTHORINFO WHERE 1 = 1
AND AUTHOR_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')

/* com.portal.security.authority.AuthorManageMapper.selectAuthorAllList */ SELECT AUTHOR_CODE AS authorCode, AUTHOR_NM AS authorNm, AUTHOR_DC AS authorDc, AUTHOR_CREAT_DE AS authorCreatDe FROM LETTNAUTHORINFO ORDER BY AUTHOR_CODE ASC
